prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, reorder] Defer Sign-In After Adoption: Move the sign_in screen after the pet adoption flow so users build an emotional connection with their pet before being asked to create an account.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
1: [finish, new_screen] Interactive Controls Tutorial Screen: Insert a new interactive guide screen before home intro showing users how to move, hide, and talk to their pet on the desktop.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_controls_guide", "home_intro"], "home_intro": {"headline": "Meet Your Desktop Companion!", "body": "Your pet is now active on your desktop screen."}}
2: [adoption, redesign] Grid View Pet Companion Redesign: Redesign pet selection screen into a visual grid featuring interactive animations for each pet choice.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "grid", "headline": "Choose Your New Desktop Pet", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "label": "Select Companion", "style": "playful", "action": "choose"}]}}
3: [adoption, new_flow] Preset Pet Instant Adoption Option: Replace custom photo uploads with instant pre-configured pet templates to bypass long custom generation times.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"replace": {"pet_choices": [{"role": "pet_choices", "type": "choice_cards", "label": "Instant Adoption Pets", "style": "emphasis", "action": "choose"}]}}}
4: [home, wait_info] Interactive Desktop Tips During Wait: Show revolving desktop shortcut tips and pet care hints while the pet finishes loading in the background.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 5, "components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "text": "Tip: Right-click your pet on the desktop anytime to open quick interactions!", "style": "calm"}]}}
5: [sign_in, hint] Account Sync Safety Notice: Add an explicit safety badge and hint assuring users that signing in preserves and syncs their existing pet data.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in safely saves your pet progress and syncs existing pets to this desktop device."}}
6: [adoption, incentive] Official Adoption Certificate Reward: Add an official adoption badge and celebratory confirmation to the certificate screen upon finishing pet setup.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"headline": "Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "body": "Your companion is officially registered and ready to join your desktop!", "components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Verified Desktop Companion", "style": "highlight"}]}}
7: [choose_path, layout] Simplified Path Choice Layout: Change path selection to a structured two-column layout with concise path option cards.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Select Your Adoption Path", "body": "Choose between adopting a classic companion or designing a custom pet."}}
8: [home, notification] Desktop Spawn Notification Prompt: Enable desktop readiness notifications on the waiting screen so users know exactly when their pet appears.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "body": "We will pop up a quick notification as soon as your pet lands on your screen."}}
9: [finish, hint] Desktop Quick Shortcut Guide: Add a visual keyboard shortcut callout on the home completion screen detailing how to toggle desktop pet visibility.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Quick shortcut: Click your desktop tray icon or press Ctrl+Shift+P to show or hide your pet!"}}

verdicts.reason: Reordering sign_in step after adoption is explicitly allowed by Rule 4.
Adding a new interactive guide screen inside onboarding is permitted.
Redesigning pick_friend into a grid layout maintains its core function.
Replacing and removing custom photo uploads violates the rule that no onboarding step may be removed or skipped.
Adding tips to the waiting screen is permitted within onboarding.
Adding an account sync notice to sign_in is allowed.
Adding a badge to the adoption certificate retains its core function.
Redesigning choose_path to a two-column layout still provides both adoption options.
Adding notifications to the waiting screen is allowed under Rule 4.
Adding a shortcut hint to the home intro overlay is permitted within onboarding.
